rule: At the soak concurrency (32), rank worker counts by throughput; take the highest whose added p95 is no more than 10% above the p95 of the next-best option by throughput; otherwise step down.
note: Applied at peak throughput instead (any level), the same rule would pick 2 workers: 114.8 req/s (p95 1730.4 ms at c=128) vs 4 workers 112.2 req/s (p95 1885.4 ms); the two differ by 2.3%.
